query:
SELECT m.timeSlot, s.companyName as sponsor, m.id as meetingId
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId = '9322701'
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
